language.title: Language

access.title: Account access
access.admin: Your Administrator profile provides access to the admin console and platform-wide configuration.
access.lhu: Your LHU Manager profile provides access to LHU-wide KPIs and the healthcare-space hierarchy starting at your assigned LHU.
access.unit: Your Unit Manager profile provides access to unit-wide KPIs and the healthcare-space hierarchy starting at your assigned Unit.
access.service: Your Service Manager profile provides access to service KPIs and the healthcare-space hierarchy starting at your assigned Service.
access.default: Your profile provides basic access to the platform.

unit.title: Select the unit context
unit.body: Select the parent LHU only to identify the unit. The resulting dashboard exposes unit-level information and does not provide access to LHU metrics or navigation.

form.title: Unit mapping
form.body: Complete both levels to unlock the unit dashboard.

service.title: Select the service context
service.body: Map the service through its parent locations. Parent selections are used only to identify the service and do not provide access to parent-level dashboards or information.

form.title: Service mapping
form.body: Complete each level in order to unlock the service overview.

overview.title: {{service}} overview
overview.body: Service-level capacity, activity and resource status.

areas.title: Service areas
areas.body: Occupancy within areas assigned to this service
